description: This file defines a function to create an API client that uses fetch or a mock API depending on configuration flags. It exports createApiClient which returns methods for making HTTP requests (get, post, put, delete).

methods.name: createApiClient(getToken)
methods.description: Creates and returns an API client object with methods for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, utilizing fetch or mockApi based on the feature flag.

methods.name: request(path, options = {})
methods.description: Internal async function that performs an HTTP request to the specified path with given options, adding authorization headers and handling response content.
